currentParagraphText: “The True Blessing is certainly still on the table if an opportunity ever presents itself and you continue to prove yourself worthy of receiving one. I cannot promise when it may become available,” the Seeker shook his head. “My current Chosen is S-grade and rapidly approaching the peak of their grade, but it’s still hard to make any kind of timeline. You’ll likely have to wait for her to either successfully ascend to godhood or fail and have me relinquish the Blessing, but who knows, you could get lucky and have her die tomorrow.”
